title: Don't Sell the Cat – pawnshop horror game for Mac and Windows | Didim Labs

jsonld.name: Don't Sell the Cat
jsonld.description: First-person horror game set in a pawnshop that opened in 1958. Over seven nights you check items with a loupe, a UV lamp, a scale and the shop cat, pay the rent, and decide who to trust. About two hours to a first ending; ten endings.

props.title: Don't Sell the Cat
props.lead: Seven nights behind the counter of a pawnshop that opened in 1958. Check what people bring in with a loupe, a UV lamp, a scale and the shop cat. Pay the rent. The ledger writes lines you didn't write, and someone knocks on the back shutter after closing. Don't open it.
props.meta: Mac and Windows in one purchase · about 2 hours · English, 한국어

image.alt: Title art: a black cat with yellow eyes on a pawnshop counter, a man's silhouette behind it

props.text: The demo is the first three nights. On a Mac with Apple Silicon, [install Soju](../#install), open **Didim Labs Store** and press **Free demo**. It downloads, installs and shows up in your library like any other game. Demo saves are kept apart from the full game's.

Pell & Daughter Loans, 1414 Corvin Street. The owner leaves notes and never comes down. Customers come in one at a time: a mother with a ring, a man who won't take cash, a nurse from the hospital across the street who always comes back for what she pawns. Fakes show under the loupe, under UV or on the scale. Cursed things are harder; Moth, the cat, hisses at them. Most nights.

items.title: 7 nights
items.text: 22 scripted visits, plus 14 neighbourhood regulars whose cases change every run.

items.title: Choices stick
items.text: What you buy, sell or refuse changes who comes back and what they say.

items.title: 10 endings
items.text: Two only appear in the Second Ledger, a harder run that opens after you finish once.

items.title: Few big scares
items.text: No gore. Flashing lights can be turned down in Settings. No voice acting.

props.title: Buy and install
props.intro: Checkout is handled by Polar, our reseller, which also takes care of sales tax. You get a license key and both downloads; the Polar customer portal lets you get them again with your email.

items.title: Pay on Polar
items.text: [Buy for $6.99](https://buy.polar.sh/polar_cl_RUBxcP2f3cFwGAUA0yXiuQcMm12Mu0kMaTJEB2yhNh2). The receipt email has your license key.

items.title: Mac
items.text: Install [Soju](../), open the Didim Labs Store tab, choose **I have a key** and paste it. Soju downloads, checks and installs the game.

items.title: Windows
items.text: Download the Windows zip from the receipt, unzip it and run the exe. [Windows install steps](../windows.html).

props.text: The Windows version will also be on Steam.

props.label: System requirements
head: Mac
Windows
rows: DirectX 12 GPU (runs on Intel HD 615 at Low)

items.q: How long is Don't Sell the Cat?
items.a: About two hours to a first ending. There are ten endings; two only open in the Second Ledger, a harder second run unlocked after finishing once.

items.q: Does Don't Sell the Cat run on Mac?
items.a: Yes, natively on Apple Silicon (M1 or newer, macOS 12+). Buy it here and install it through Soju's store tab with your license key. One purchase includes the Windows version too.
There are only a few big scares, and no gore. Flashing lights can be turned down in Settings.
English and Korean, for both interface and text. There is no voice acting.

items.q: Was AI used to make it?
items.a: Some 3D character and item models were generated with Meshy and edited for the game, and story text was drafted with AI help and rewritten by us. Props, sound and music were not made with AI. Nothing is generated while you play.

props.text: 1958년에 문을 연 전당포의 야간 카운터에서 일곱 밤을 보내는 1인칭 공포 게임입니다. 손님이 가져온 물건을 확대경, UV 램프, 저울, 가게 고양이로 확인하고 집세를 냅니다. 장부에는 내가 쓰지 않은 줄이 생기고, 문을 닫으면 누군가 뒷문 셔터를 두드립니다.
첫 결말까지 약 2시간, 결말 10개, 한국어 지원. $6.99에 맥판과 윈도우판이 같이 들어 있습니다. 맥에서는 [소주](../ko/)의 Didim Labs Store 탭에서 영수증 메일의 키를 넣으면 설치됩니다.
